snapshot_rules.external_github_evidence: record evidence_id + ref + observed branch head + observed blob sha
snapshot_rules.self_hosted_github_evidence: resolve and record exact blob sha for the referenced file at pack build
snapshot_rules.author_declaration: record declaration id + exact author-declaration registry blob sha when available

invalidation_rules.when: external source head differs from current Navigator freshness policy
invalidation_rules.action: re-recover only affected source/evidence slice before high-confidence reuse

invalidation_rules.when: self-hosted evidence file blob differs from pack snapshot

invalidation_rules.action: re-evaluate author-declared claims in the pack

invalidation_rules.when: current source identity cannot be resolved
invalidation_rules.action: do not present pack as verified fresh
